{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tallaan Shipyards Orbital Starfighter Repair Depot''' was a spherical [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Tallaan system/Legends|Tallaan system]]. Part of the [[Tallaani Shipyards]], it serviced [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] repairs for both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Freeworlds Common Navy]].<ref name="BH">{{WEGCite|story=The Bacta Heist|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}} {{1st}}</ref>
